title: Structure à l'infini des Mg,ν [pages 1 à 90, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context: section 8 of Grothendieck's notes on the 'structure at infinity' of the compactified moduli stacks \hat M_{g,ν}, where '!' denotes the version with numbered marked points. On the previous page he reduced the strata of modular dimension ≤ 2 to a few 'elementary' cases: \hat M^!_{0,4}, \hat M^!_{1,1}, \hat M^!_{0,5}, \hat M^!_{1,2}. He believes that understanding the discrete (analytic) fundamental groupoids in these cases is the key to the general case. This is the two-level principle of the Esquisse.

On this page he announces the plan. Starting from the corresponding elementary 'MD-graphes', meaning Mumford–Deligne dual graphs of stable curves, he wants to make explicit, in the main cases, the structure of the specializations between strata of \hat M_{g,ν} and \hat M^!_{g,ν}.

He then opens §8, 'Structure of the specializations of strata in modular dimension ≤ 2', with case 1°, \hat M^!_{0,4} and \hat M_{0,4}.

Diagram (76) lists the strata by codimension:
- Codimension 0: the one-vertex graph, a genus-0 vertex carrying the marked set I with |I| = 4.
- Codimension 1: the two-vertex, one-edge graph, with vertices carrying I' and I'' of cardinality 2 each.
- The arrow labelled 3 means the generic stratum specializes in 3 distinct ways to the codimension-1 stratum, one for each of the three partitions of I into two 2-element blocks.

This matches the fact that the boundary of the compactified M_{0,4} consists of 3 points, the three points at infinity of U_{0,3} = P^1 \ {0,1,∞}. Formula (77) records:
- \hat M^!_{0,4} ≅ P^1_Z (Knudsen's result that the compactified M_{0,4} is P^1 over Z);
- M^!_{0,4} ≅ (U_{0,3})_Z = P^1_Z \ {0,1,∞}, via the cross-ratio λ.

The page ends: 'to do it properly one should also make explicit' the universal curve with its four sections and the S_4-action (continued on the next page). The next page then passes to the unordered stack \hat M_{0,4}: there is a single point at infinity with automorphism data, and the orbifold Euler characteristic is χ = -1/24 = χ(U_{0,3})/|S_4|.
errors: No mathematical errors on this page. Diagram (76), the count of 3 boundary points and (77) are all correct, the last over Z as well (Knudsen).

ideas.what: Stratification of the compactified moduli stack by stable (Mumford–Deligne) dual graphs, with specializations of strata indexed by graph data. For \bar M_{0,4}: one open stratum and 3 boundary points, corresponding to the 3 partitions of 4 points into 2+2.
ideas.modern_name: Dual-graph stratification of \bar M_{g,n}; boundary divisors D_{I'|I''}
ideas.usually_credited_to: Deligne–Mumford (1969); Knudsen (1983); stratification formalized e.g. by Kontsevich–Manin / Getzler–Kapranov (1990s)
ideas.where_published: The Esquisse d'un programme (1984) discusses the stratification at infinity of \hat M_{g,ν} and the Teichmüller tower informally.

ideas.what: \bar M_{0,4} ≅ P^1_Z, with interior P^1 minus {0,1,∞}
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme (M_{0,4} as the projective line minus three points)

ideas.what: Programme of studying the specializations between strata in modular dimension ≤ 2 as the key to the full structure at infinity
ideas.modern_name: Two-level principle / Grothendieck–Teichmüller tower generated by levels 1 and 2
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck (Esquisse); proved in various forms by Drinfeld, Ihara, Lochak–Schneps, Nakamura, Hatcher–Lochak–Schneps

deep.surprise_reason: The page sets up a systematic treatment and works out only the trivial case of \bar M_{0,4} (3 boundary points), which is completely standard. The programmatic two-level idea is already published in the Esquisse.
transcription_corrections: 'les grandes cas' is probably 'les premiers cas' or 'les grands cas'; the inserted phrase reads 'des spécialisations entre', so the sentence is 'la structure des spécialisations entre strates des \hat M_{g,ν}...'.
The insertion '{+en par[?] g[?]...ts[?]+}' is likely 'en partageant' or 'se partageant', i.e. the set I 'se partageant suivant l'une quelconque des trois partitions'.
'donne, donc 3 spécialisations' reads as 'donne donc 3 spécialisations différentes'.
'ce correspond bien' should be 'cela correspond bien'.
'en avec' before (77) is likely 'en accord avec'.
'Codim 0 / Codim 1' and 'I(4)', 'I'(2)', 'I''(2)' are correctly read; the arrow is labelled 3.
